headline: Both defects had exactly one authored source each, not the volume either report implied: defect 1 is ONE leaked stance fragment (5 shipped lines, not a pattern repeated across the corpus); defect 2 corrupts 24 books (not 162 — 162 is the manifest's own entry count, a different number from the defect surface). what_i_could_not_do: No browser was used anywhere in this piece — the box is over its HAZARDS §29 contention ceiling and this was text/data work throughout, so `tools/contention.mjs` was never invoked and no screenshot or motion capture of either fix exists. I verified both fixes by calling the ACTUAL world-side consumer functions (`greetingFor()` from game/src/character/converse.js; `foldBooks()` from the new game/src/data/fold-books.js) directly in Node against the real shipped data files — a stronger, reproducible, CI-checkable property than a single screenshot, but it does not confirm pixels: font rendering, line-wrap of the new greeting text, and the-sap-and-the-ledger's page-break layout were never looked at. A critic with browser access should still orbit Corvus Aldeyn (blackwood-company-factor, Lilmoth) for the greeting and open the-sap-and-the-ledger for the book, per the character/visual-claim directive.

Did not extend the load-order-independence fix to the other three places engine.js folds `Object.values(this.data.books)` (`_opacityWorldIndex` line ~2882, `_canonWorldIndex` line ~2941, `_bookKnowledgeIndex` line ~5516). defect_1_dialogue_authoring_leak.how_the_full_search_was_done: Two passes, not one. (1) A broad regex scan (20+ patterns: authoring briefs, placeholders, todo/fixme markers, template brackets, character/word-limit language, 'stay in character', 'as an ai', etc.) over every string value under every 'lines'/'text'/'x'/'greeting'/'a' key in game/data/dialogue/** and game/data/books/**, plus a wider ad-hoc sweep of game/data/npcs/**, game/data/quests/**, game/data/factions/**, game/data/lore/**. Every hit individually read; 42 were false positives (design/provenance notes like '_note'/'order_note'/'corpus_item', quest 'notes'/'consequence'/'outcome' fields — none of which are rendered to the player — and one genuine false positive inside actual book prose: the-short-measures.json books[6].text contains 'asked him to say in one line what the working papers were for', which is a character being characterised, not a leak). (2) Read the FULL authored source of gen-greetings.mjs (all 300 STANCE lines, all 60 ADDRESS lines) by eye, since that is where a future leak would actually be introduced, not just its 5x-per-fragment combinatorial expansion. Found exactly one contaminated fragment.

defect_2_books_render_undefined.reported_unverified_number: 162 entries with 0 carrying a text field

derived_numbers.manifest_entries: 162, 0 with a text field — python3 json check, matches the report exactly. This is the manifest's OWN size, not the defect's blast radius.
derived_numbers.how_derived: Simulated the exact fold Engine._buildUI() ran (before this fix) over the real 26 game/data/books/*.json files in the real order game/data/index.json lists them (manifest.json is #5 of 26 — grep -n '"path": "books/' game/data/index.json | nl). 24 book ids that have real text in an earlier-loading file (a-progress-through-the-southern-marsh.json: 3, deep-time.json: 8, foundational.json: 7, interface-readables.json: 6) get permanently overwritten by manifest.json's title-only stub for the same id, because no file loading after manifest.json (indices 6-26) redeclares those same ids. Cross-checked: manifest's 162 ids are EXACTLY the union of real book ids across the other 25 files (0 manifest ids missing a real source; 0 real ids absent from manifest) — manifest really is a pure catalog by design, the bug is that the loader could not tell a catalog entry from a content entry.
derived_numbers.one_confirmed_live_from_the_brief: the-sap-and-the-ledger (foundational.json) — verified: foldBooks() over real data now returns its full 4783-character authored text (starts 'Being an Attempt at an Honest Accounting of the Argonian Soul...') instead of undefined.
derived_numbers.render_path_traced: game/src/ui/system.js#_bookModel -> game/src/ui/screens/text.js#bookPagination(b.text, S) -> wrap(text, ...); an undefined `text` is what turns into the literal word 'undefined' on the page, matching the exact reported symptom.

defect_2_books_render_undefined.mechanism_verified_as_load_order_not_mis: Confirmed it is a LOAD-ORDER collision, not a missing-field defect in the manifest: manifest.json is intentionally shaped as a catalog ({id, title} only) and every one of its 162 ids has a real text-bearing counterpart elsewhere in the corpus. The defect is that Engine._buildUI()'s old fold treated every books/*.json document as equally authoritative and let whichever loaded LAST win unconditionally, with no distinction between a catalog stub and real content.
defect_2_books_render_undefined.fix: Extracted the fold into game/src/data/fold-books.js#foldBooks(dataBooks) — pure, no DOM, load-order-independent: a textless entry can never overwrite an entry that already has text, regardless of which file loaded when. game/src/engine.js's _buildUI() (was inline at line ~4567) now imports and calls this shared function instead of the old unconditional-overwrite loop.

standing_check.what_it_does: Imports the REAL foldBooks() (the exact function the game calls, not a reimplementation), loads the real 26 books/*.json files in the real index.json order, and asserts every resulting book has a non-empty text field.
standing_check.self_test: --self-test also runs the OLD unconditional-overwrite fold (kept verbatim as a permanent negative control) over the SAME real data.
